scenes.say: Antonelli was fastest in Vegas qualifying. But he won't start from pole.
Antonelli beat Verstappen by a quarter of a second. Russell and Norris were close.
But it's his sixth engine of the season, against a limit of four. A five-place penalty drops him to sixth.
So Verstappen gets pole, Russell joins him. Norris and Hadjar make row two.
Piastri took a fifth engine: a ten-place drop, so he starts seventeenth.
Sainz, Stroll and Bearman also changed engine parts and go to the back.
Out in Q1: Camara, Perez, Alonso, Stroll, Bottas and Bearman.
And in Q2 both Ferraris went out: Leclerc eleventh, Hamilton twelfth.
Leclerc made a mistake on his best lap and ran out of time. Hamilton was short of grip.

title: Las Vegas qualifying: Antonelli fastest, but Verstappen starts from pole
